_comment: The box registry of the full-data runs (kitsune/fullrun.py; build contract 2.3 and 7), hand-written next to the configs tools/make_full_configs.py generates: its --check validates this file with fullrun.registry_problems, tests/test_full_configs.py checks the numbers below. Launch reads it at the commit it rents (GPU count, data config, hours, price cap, extra disk, watchdog); the queue (kitsune/full_queue.py) its items. HOURS. Each box's est_hours / max_hours (launch's planned hours and the watchdog cap) are plan v3's for smoke A 5.2 / 9 and smoke B 1.75 / 3 (not rescaled); boxes full-t, full-p and p01 (box 1's run again: the recipe test, DECISIONS H1) are measured (below). Smoke A's train items carry plan v3's run hours at the smoke's epochs (3 / 3 / 4 / 4, make_full_configs SMOKE_EPOCHS) rescaled to the step count tools/full_plan.py measured on full.parquet (configs/full/plan/full_study.json, its full part), rounded to 2 decimals, as plan_hours, with plan_total_steps = those step counts, for smoke check 3 (projected hours = the smoke's s/step x plan_total_steps; factor = plan_hours / projected): t06 35.19 x 71,946 / 73,452 = 34.47; p03 22.29 x 105,861 / 109,608 = 21.53; p01 13.56 x 107,910 / 110,520 = 13.24; p005 9.92 x 107,910 / 110,528 = 9.685 -> 9.69. The train items' max_hours (the no-start rule's need) and the est / max hours of boxes full-t, full-p and p01 are make_full_configs.box_hours of the speed record configs/full/plan/box2_hours.json (make_full_configs --import-speed: smoke A's measured s/step per student, check 3, and box 1's measurement, tools/box1_go.py --revision c4604304: r 1.0361, o 0.0465, CTC store 0.548 h, bootstrap 3.09 h) at the step counts of the plan record's launch part (full.parquet at the epochs the boxes run now: DECISIONS G1 as the owner confirmed it on 2026-10-02, T-0.6B 3, P-0.3B 3, P-0.05B 5, the earlier 10-epoch request withdrawn; P-0.05B postponed since, DECISIONS H2, its config kept, its items off box full-p; P-0.1B's recipe test box 1's own 4, DECISIONS H1), a run with the augmentation recipe at make_full_configs.AUGMENT_STEP_FACTOR 1.05 x its s/step (concat's longer rows). --check (tools/make_full_configs.py registry_drift) holds smoke A's plan_total_steps / plan_hours and F4's seconds to the plan record, and those boxes' hours to the speed record. RAM: a box's min_ram_gb (null: launch's 64 GB a GPU) is the host RAM launch's offer filter asks for; boxes full-t, full-p and p01 ask 96 GB (2.3x the highest real peak; box 1's queue summary's 164 GB peak_rss_gb is VmRSS summed over the trainer and its 8 DataLoader workers, the stores' page cache counted once per process, not a need). END RESERVE. A readout starts right after its run with the run's KITSUNE_DEADLINE, so after a run the deadline cooldown (4d) shortened it gets what the trainer's final saves and uploads leave of the run's schedule.end_reserve_min, and the no-start rule skips it if its max_hours need more. full-t06's end reserve is therefore 55 min (m4-full-t06's 45 min + 10 min for the trainer's end phase; the default 30 would leave about 28 min and lose T-0.6B's M4 with every item that needs it), the P runs keep 30 (18 + 10). --check refuses a readout of a full box that no longer fits (make_full_configs READOUT_RESERVE): a PR that raises a readout's max_hours raises its run's end reserve with it. Readout, eval and speed items' max_hours are estimates [X]: the no-start rule's need (a droppable item that cannot end before its KITSUNE_DEADLINE is skipped) and, with stall_min null, the overrun kill at 2 x max_hours. STALL LIMITS are kitsune.fullrun.STALL_MIN_DEFAULT except smoke A's trainers (10 min: F1's stopped trainer is killed and resumed within one) and smoke A's speed items (null: contract 7 and Resolution 28 time them by the overrun rule). No argv uses {state}: in the chained box (contract addendum E) a part's state dir is chain/<part>. CHAIN. p01-chain (addendum E.1.7) runs full-smoke and smoke-b (stage 1, gated by full-smoke's checks 1-11), then p01 (stage 2) on one rental: it names those boxes as parts and has no items, data config or watchdog of its own; kitsune.fullrun derives its spec (box_spec: box 1's data config for the disk and the gate, full-smoke's alert watchdog for stage 1) and checks each part's extent within its stage's rebuild config, and stage 1's within stage 2's.

full-smoke._comment: Smoke A (contract 5: the built-in checks 1-11) on 1x RTX 5090: the study extent and the smoke selection (a seeded 100 h draw with its own dev slice), both stores in order (CTC first), the four smoke trainers (the full configs cut to the 100 h draw: smoke-t06 and smoke-p03 force an early stop, check 10), smoke-nostart (max_hours 999: the no-start rule must skip it, check 6), the M4 readouts of one student per family, the bf16 speed probes of the 7 study students and the 3 teacher paths on the study's 200 ids (check 11), and the fault schedule F1-F5 (check 7; watchdog alert only, so F5's frozen controller heartbeat raises an alert instead of stopping the box).

faults._comment: S = 150 s. Contract 7 bounds S by 0.5 x smoke-p005's projected run time = its steps on the smoke selection (tools/full_plan.py on smoke.parquet at micro 1600 / step 1500 / 4 epochs: 234 + 234 + 233 + 234 = 935) x plan v3's s/step of full-p005 (9.92 h x 3600 / 110,528 steps = 0.3231 s) = 0.5 x 935 x 0.3231 = 151.05 s, rounded down to 10 s. The item's KITSUNE_DEADLINE is its start + 150 s. 4d is off in the smoke phase and needs a 20-step rate window, so it first acts at step 120, when setup, memory probe and smoke phase have used the 150 s: it logs deadline_cooldown with action start and no_time_left, and the run ends there with its end phase (check 8 accepts start; check 2 exempts the deadline item from its 300 steps; check 3 reads steps 101-120).

p01._comment: Box p01: the P TEST BOX of DECISIONS H8 (the owner on 2026-10-05, after the P-0.3B review: "retrain p0.1 and p0.05 with the changes and see if our changes fixed the problem"). RECIPE V3 (make_full_configs RECIPE_V3) = recipe v2 (truncate 0.2 on rows >= 3 s, drawn cut ends, concat 0.5, mixing off) plus the review's two fixes: B, end_trim_p 0.3 (rows that are not cut lose their trailing silence, their mark's frames moved up behind their last word) and A, background audio under 30 % of the rows (noise_p 0.3, 0-20 dB: MUSAN music without vocals and noise, the bank aug/musan-bg-v1 this box pulls as an extra dir; the targets the teacher's on the clean audio). Two runs, one queue: (1) box 1's cooldown again, launch --box p01 --resume-reset full-p01-20261001T184145Z with one --resume-set per RECIPE_V3 key and schedule.epochs=4 (make_full_configs continuation_flags): from its pre_cooldown state checkpoints/full_step_86328 to the same T 107,910, so a paired comparison with A0 (box 1, runs-repo revision c4604304, M4 11.45 %) and A1 (the first recipe test, revision 41ce1f0, M4 11.65 %); its readout goes to runs/m4-full-p01-20261001T184145Z-r2; (2) P-0.05B from step 0 at 5 epochs with RECIPE_V3 (configs/full/full-p005.json, T 134,887). Each with its M4 readout and 7 quantised readouts. The Parakeet labels only (data-p01). HOURS (make_full_configs.box_hours; --check holds them): full-p01 2.11 h (the re-run's 21,582 steps and 8 dev checks at box 1's pace x 1.05 for concat), full-p005 8.0 h (x 1.05); est 13.2 = setup 1.6 + the CTC store 0.548 + the runs + the readouts, quant, resume-pull and check-resume tail 0.5 + end 0.35; max 21 = the pessimistic setup and store, the runs x 1.26, the tail 1.3, the 45 min reserve and one stall (P-0.05B ends 2.95 h before its deadline cooldown would act). The background and the end trim are loader work (one add, one slice per row): no GPU time. min_ram_gb 96. extra_gb 45: the bank (2.3 GiB), P-0.1B's and P-0.05B's states and exports.

full-t._comment: Box T (DECISIONS G2, 2026-10-02: box 2 as two 1x RTX 5090 boxes; the retired 2x box full): T-0.6B alone at 8 epochs (DECISIONS H7, the owner on 2026-10-05 after P-0.3B's 6-epoch result: "prepare the T-box run with 8 epochs with the same recipe"; 3 under G1 before; COMMON's early-stop patience 6) WITH THE AED RECIPE (configs/full/full-t06.json augment: recipe v2 - truncate_p 0.2, rows under 3 s never cut, concat_p 0.5, mixing off, no pads - on the Cohere token targets, kitsune.trainset's "AED rows"; a cut lands where the cut table labels/full/selections/full_study/aed_cuts.parquet says the Parakeet teacher's CTC alignment has a word start that maps onto the Cohere tokens, and keeps the Cohere tokens before it, then EOS; augment.cuts_sha256 pins the table; make_full_configs RECIPE_AED) on the Cohere labels only (data-t: family aed, teacher_out for every stem, no Parakeet labels: the table, pulled as an extra file, is all the box needs of them), its AED store, its binding M4 readout, its 7 quantised readouts and the decision-22 re-time pair (speed-full-t06 against speed-study-t06 on this machine, one speed.json: the report's S2 ratio, which only the ratio uses; the chart's speed numbers are smoke-B #2's host). HOURS (make_full_configs.box_hours of configs/full/plan/box2_hours.json: smoke A's s/step x box 1's ratio r 1.0361, o 0.0465; --check holds them): full-t06 191,855 steps (8 epochs on full.parquet) at 1.05 x its s/step for concat's longer rows (AUGMENT_STEP_FACTOR) = 63.62 h (60.61 h without); est 66.8 = setup 1.6 (F3's parallel downloads) + one store 0.548 (box 1's CTC store; the AED-only store taken as equal) + 63.62 + its readout, quant and re-time tail 0.6 + end 0.35 (66.718, rounded up); max 88 = ceil(pessimistic setup 3.3 + store 0.76 + 63.62 x 1.26 + tail 1.35 + the 60 min reserve + one stall 1.25 = 87.82): T-0.6B ends 1.86 h before its deadline cooldown would act. Host max rental >= 88 / 24 + 0.5 = 4.17 d (launch's min_rental_days of the cap). RAM: min_ram_gb 96 (T-0.6B's full-extent peak is unmeasured, about 33-38 GiB expected; box 1 peaked at 33 GiB for the trainer, 37 for its store build; the cut table's join at the trainer's start holds ~2 GB for a minute). extra_gb 70: T-0.6B's states (~8.6 GB x 2 local + pre_cooldown + staging), 7 exports, study-t06's weights, and the cut table and its joined index (~1.2 GB).

full-p._comment: Box P (DECISIONS G2; H1 step 2): P-0.3B at 6 epochs (DECISIONS H5, the owner on 2026-10-03 after the recipe test; 3 under G1 before; COMMON's early-stop patience 6) WITH RECIPE V2 (DECISIONS H6; configs/full/full-p03.json augment: enabled, truncate_p 0.2, concat_p 0.5, mix_p 0.0 = mixing off, truncate_min_row_s 3.0 = rows under 3 s never cut, the other augment keys the trainer's defaults - the quiet pads off: the CPU pilot showed them moving the mark bias only; every cut row's audio ends at a drawn sample, trainset.end_samples, since the first recipe's model learned the 80 ms boundary as its no-mark cue; make_full_configs RECIPE, after box p01's test of the first recipe, make_full_configs RECIPE_TEST, and its external review), on the Parakeet labels (data-p: data-p01's content, parakeet_out for every stem, teacher_out for the eval stems), one 1x RTX 5090 queue: the CTC store, P-0.3B and its readout, then the eval pool: P-0.3B's 7 quantised readouts and the 4 Whisper models. Launched after the recipe test on box p01 and its review (H1 step 2; H6: the owner's "fix, then launch P-0.3B anew with the new recipe", without a second test box). P-0.05B is postponed (H2): its config full-p005.json stays, its train item, readout and 7 quantised readouts left this box. No speed items: every comparative speed number comes from one host, smoke-B #2's (tools/full_report.py's chart group). HOURS (make_full_configs.box_hours; --check holds them): full-p03 211,720 steps (6 epochs) at 1.05 x its s/step for concat's longer rows (AUGMENT_STEP_FACTOR) = 26.53 h (25.28 h without); est 30.0 = setup 1.6 + one store 0.548 + 26.53 + the pool 0.9 + end 0.35 (29.928, rounded up); max 42 = ceil(3.3 + 0.76 + 26.53 x 1.26 + the pool's worst 1.65 + 60 min + one stall 1.25 = 41.39): P-0.3B ends 3.01 h before its deadline cooldown would act. The pool tail is still the two-run pool's (P-0.05B's M4 and quantised readouts, ~0.2 h, kept as margin). Host max rental >= 42 / 24 + 0.5 = 2.25 d, so launch's 4 d. min_ram_gb 96 (real peaks about 40 GiB: the store build, then one trainer). extra_gb 60 (sized for two P runs: kept): the P states, the exports, ~7 GB of Whisper snapshots.

smoke-b._comment: Smoke B (the registry verdict specs of checks 12-16; report only) on 1x RTX 5090 with the frozen study selection and study weights: torchao's kernels (12: the selftest - with F4's torchao-parity, zero-row, compiled-block and padded-checkpoint sub-checks, hence max_hours 0.5 - and emulate mode against the real NVFP4 W4A4 path within 0.1 pp CER on JSUT and CV8), no non-finite rows (13: fp16 on every study student, and the quant-* and mem-* readouts of every trio format: the padded batches where pre-F1 fp8 made NaN), int8 W8A8 / NVFP4 W4A4 / MXFP4 / FP8 W8A8 exported to safetensors and scored identically to the in-memory variant (14; fp8-w8a8 added for F1: its bf16 weight scales file against memory, through torchao on padded batches), Whisper large-v3 on JSUT within 5.1-9.1 % CER and the other three on 50 rows per set (15), and the speed probes (16: every speed item done; a --quant or --compile probe exits 4, so fails, when its CER is more than 5 pp above the same weights' bf16 decode - F4, tools/speed_probe.py SANITY_MAX_DELTA; the bf16 re-time of the study students and teachers is not_needed, pass null, on smoke A's machine). DECISIONS F2: this box, standalone, verifies the F1 / F4 quant and compile fixes on a GPU before box 2 launches. Every item that reads the eval store <root>/cache/eval needs stores-eval, which builds it from configs/study/study-t06.json (the lr and max_steps the generated study config leaves null set for its validation); every item has max_hours, so the no-start rule drops one that no longer fits (in the chained box: before the stage-1 sub-deadline).

p01-chain._comment: DECISIONS D (2026-09-30): smoke A + smoke B + box 1 on one 1x RTX 5090 rental. Stage 1 rebuilds the study extent and runs full-smoke, then smoke-b; full-smoke's verdict checks 1-11 gate stage 2 automatically. Stage 2 rebuilds the rest of the full extent (the study extent's shards are reused) and runs box p01. Contract addendum E. HOURS (E.6, E.9.5): est 25.2 = the central wall (smoke A 5.2 + smoke B's items 1.1 + stage-2 setup 4.7 + full-p01 13.56 + readout 0.3 + end 0.35); max 35 = stage 1's 10.5 + the pessimistic stage-2 setup 6.1 + smoke check 3's box-1 limit 17 + readout 0.3 + end 0.35 + the 45 min reserve, since no owner round trip re-projects box 1's cap after the gate; gate_by_hours 9 = full-smoke's own cap. launch refuses a --max-hours below 10.5 + p01's est_hours 19.5 = 30 h. DISK: extra_gb 120 = p01's 25 + ~95 GB stage-1 leftovers (smoke run dirs, stores, exports, the Whisper and study-weight caches), added to box 1's sizing (data-p01). HISTORY: the chain ran once, 2026-10-01 (instance 53693389: its gate failed checks 5 and 7; box 1 then ran as box p01 alone, instance 53711872). Its part p01 is now P-0.1B's continuation box with 7 quantised readouts, so a relaunch of this chain would also need smoke-B #2's quant go signal; it stays defined as history, never launched again.
